title: Run public lotteries only under the exclusive operator licence
what: Public lotteries may be run only under an operator licence; one granted as exclusive bars any other operator licence during its exclusivity period.

sources.title: Public Lotteries Act 1996 (NSW)
sources.quote: 18 Exclusive operator licence (1) An operator licence can, if the Minister thinks fit, be granted as an exclusive licence for any period (the exclusivity period) up to the term for which the licence is granted. (2) If an operator licence is granted as an exclusive licence, no other operator licence can be granted to be in force during the exclusivity period.

assessment.summary: An operator licence for public lotteries may be granted as an exclusive licence, and no other operator licence may then be granted during its exclusivity period (keno aside). A statutory exclusive right to run lotteries.

marks.reason: No other lottery operator may be licensed during the exclusivity period.
The exclusive operator faces no rival in its market.

assessment.confidence_note: The Act allows exclusivity; whether the current licence is exclusive, and to when, is not quoted here.
